items.label: 【Next-Gen Power
items.value: Outperforms i5-1135G7】 Experience superior responsiveness with the 12th Gen Intel Core i3-1215U (6 Cores, 8 Threads, up to 4.40 GHz). This high-performance CPU beats older i5-1135G7 class processors, ensuring a lag-free experience for video editing, heavy multitasking, and modern productivity apps.

items.label: 【17.3" FHD Large Display
items.value: Desktop Replacement】 Upgrade your view with an expansive 17.3-inch Full HD display. Offering 20% more screen real estate than standard 15.6" laptops, it’s the ultimate desktop replacement for professionals and seniors. Enjoy larger text and crystal-clear visuals that reduce eye strain during long hours.

items: 【High-Speed RAM & PCIe NVMe SSD】 Eliminate bottlenecks with high-bandwidth memory and a lightning-fast NVMe SSD. Launch professional software, manage massive spreadsheets, and toggle dozens of browser tabs instantly. Features a built-in Micro SD card slot for easy storage expansion of your media libraries.

【PD 65W Fast Charging & All-Day Battery】 Stay productive anywhere with the 53.58Wh long-lasting battery. Support for 65W Power Delivery (PD) via USB-C means you can juice up quickly at airports or cafes using a single universal charger for both your laptop and phone, significantly lightening your travel bag.

【Fingerprint Security & Physical Lock Slot】 Protect your sensitive data with one-touch biometric access. The integrated Fingerprint Sensor offers instant, password-free login—perfect for libraries or dorms. Combined with a Kensington lock slot, your laptop remains both digitally and physically secure in public spaces.

【Hardware Privacy Shutter for Peace of Mind】 Take control of your privacy during Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet calls. The built-in physical privacy shutter lets you manually block the HD camera when not in use. A must-have feature for remote workers and students living in shared environments or home offices.

【Backlit Keyboard & Full-Size Numeric Keypad】 Boost your data entry efficiency with a dedicated Numpad—ideal for accountants, analysts, and students. The ergonomic backlit keyboard ensures high productivity even in dimly lit environments, late-night study sessions, or during long-haul flights.

【Pro-Level Video Calls & Immersive Audio】 Look and sound your best with the 2MP HD webcam and dual noise-reducing microphones that filter out background hum. Dual 2W stereo speakers provide crisp, loud audio, making it perfect for professional business conferencing and staying connected with family.

【Ultra-Fast Wi-Fi 6 & Bluetooth 5.2】 Enjoy 3x faster speeds and increased stability with Wi-Fi 6 technology, even in households with multiple connected devices. Bluetooth 5.2 provides a rock-solid connection for your wireless mouse, headphones, and external peripherals for a clutter-free setup.

【2-Year Warranty & Proudly Assembled in USA】 Invest with confidence. This laptop is proudly assembled in the USA and undergoes rigorous quality control. We back your purchase with an industry-leading 2-Year Warranty and a 90-day hassle-free return policy, ensuring long-term durability and elite support.
